title: Data Analyst
description:
Join our seven-person BI team and work at the intersection of business, data, and enablement. You will clarify decisions, identify the right KPIs, challenge assumptions, and deliver actionable insights. As we expand into a new AI-assisted BI platform, you will help establish governed, AI-assisted self-service analytics, experiment with new analytical approaches, and guide stakeholders through the transition.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Revenue Operations to translate business questions into clear analyses and recommendations.
* Analyze performance drivers such as pipeline, conversion, revenue, customer segments, and product usage, explaining why results changed.
* Build and maintain trusted analyses, dashboards, KPI definitions, and reusable data products in ThoughtSpot, Power BI, and Azure SQL.
* Use SQL to explore data, validate hypotheses, and investigate questions beyond existing reports.
* Improve metric consistency, documentation, lineage, data quality, and the responsible use of data and AI together with Data Engineers and business stakeholders.
* Enable users through training and practical guidance so self-service analytics supports better decisions without creating competing versions of the truth.

**YOUR PROFILE**
----------------

* At least two years of experience in data analysis, BI, analytics consulting, or Revenue Operations analytics.
* Strong business acumen and a track record of influencing decisions through analysis, not only delivering reports.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, data validation, and semantic or dimensional models.
* Hands-on experience with ThoughtSpot or another modern BI platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker as well as working with LLMs.
* Clear communication in German (depending on the location) and English, including the ability to explain assumptions, limitations, and trade-offs.
* A proactive, curious, adaptable, and accountable working style, with the creativity to explore new approaches and the confidence to challenge requests constructively.
  

**Nice to have**

* Experience with ThoughtSpot Spotter or other search-driven and AI-assisted analytics capabilities.
* Knowledge of Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics, Purview, DAX, or governed enterprise datasets.
* Experience with SaaS, subscription, usage-based licensing, sales operations, or product analytics.

**FACTS FOR YOU**
-----------------

* Many possibilities to further develop your individual skillset
* Innovative and creative work environment with plenty of room for new ideas
* A structured onboarding phase with experienced colleagues
* Flexible working hours and a family-friendly environment
* A great working atmosphere in an enthusiastic international team with flat hierarchies
* Paessler is a fast-growing midsized company that has been in the market for 20 years. The company is focused on long-term goals and is currently comprised of 400+ employees

title: Apprenticeship as an IT Specialist for System Integration (m/f/d) September 2027
description:

Are you interested in modern IT systems? Do you want to not only understand how IT works in companies, but also improve it? Then start your apprenticeship as an IT Specialist for System Integration (m/f/d) at NETWAYS Professional Services! With us, you'll learn the ropes from the ground up—and still be right in the thick of things from the very beginning. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you'll use monitoring to provide visibility into our clients' IT environments and help them streamline their operations. And when systems don't fit together easily, you develop solutions that connect them. With us, you'll find your place in the world of IT!

Since 1995, we have been helping companies build, operate, and further develop their IT infrastructures using the right open-source technologies—with a focus on monitoring and system management. We also offer training, host our own conferences such as OSMC, and provide managed services from our data center in Nuremberg.

What drives us: software with open-source code and a community where knowledge is shared rather than kept under lock and key. We have over 95 employees from more than 17 different countries—working in flat hierarchies with plenty of room to contribute their own ideas.

**Your Responsibilities & Your Scope of Work**

* Teaching the fundamentals of Linux and database administration, as well as programming, through training courses and projects

* Supporting our clients in setting up and maintaining their centralized IT monitoring systems, as well as developing custom plugins and extensions
* Simplifying IT Administration Through Server Provisioning, Patch Management, and Configuration Management
* Customer Service in Support and IT Outsourcing
* Participation in cross-departmental projects, webinars, public training sessions, and conferences

**Ideally, you should have:**

* Motivation to learn new things and continue to grow
* Team spirit and a reliable work ethic
* Some experience with IT systems is a plus, but not required
* Interest in the areas of monitoring & observability and configuration management

* A diverse training program that offers insights into many different subject areas—this will help you discover where your strengths lie and allow you to develop your skills in a targeted way
* You'll take on responsibility early on and will be able to manage your own projects

* We provide training with the goal of expanding our team in the long term—with real opportunities for your future

Curious? On our website, you can learn more about NETWAYS, our customers, and what to expect as an apprentice with us. On the team page, you'll also get a first impression of who you'd be working with in the future.

title: Apprenticeship as an IT Specialist for Application Development (m/f/d)
description:
**Apprenticeship as an IT Specialist for Application Development (m/f/d)**
  

**Apprenticeship Program for 2027, starting September 1, 2027**

Are you interested in IT, programming, and modern technologies? Do you want to do more than just watch—do you want to develop software yourself and work on real projects? Then start your apprenticeship as an IT Specialist for Application Development (m/f/d) at Icinga! With us, you'll be part of a dedicated development team right from the start and learn step by step how professional software is created. Together with experienced developers, you'll work on exciting projects, learn about modern technologies, and develop solutions that people actually use. Whether you already have some programming experience or are simply highly motivated—we'll help you develop your skills and find your place in the IT world.

#### **About Icinga:**

Icinga GmbH is the developer of one of the best-known open-source systems for IT infrastructure monitoring. Our customers use Icinga to monitor their data centers and hybrid clouds around the world—including DATEV, ING-DiBa, and Deutsche Telekom IT, as well as banks, insurance companies, and automakers from Europe, the U.S., and Asia. What began as a community project in the early years has grown into a company that still operates without investors today: Our code is open source, anyone can contribute to its development, and that is exactly what makes Icinga so adaptable. This is how our customers ensure the smooth operation of their IT infrastructure.

#### **Your Responsibilities & Your Scope of Work**

* Contributing to the development of modern open-source products
* Use of various programming languages, such as PHP, C++, or Go
* Working with modern technologies and current development environments
* Participation in internal and public training courses for professional and personal development
* Work on a variety of projects—from smaller tasks to solutions for large companies
* Work with the development team to define your personal focus—tailored to your strengths and interests

#### **Ideally, you should have the following**

* Interest in IT, software development, and new technologies
* Motivation to learn new things and continue to grow
* Team spirit and a reliable work ethic
* First Experiences with Programming

#### **Here's why you should start your apprenticeship with us**

* A diverse training program that offers insights into many different subject areas—this will help you discover where your strengths lie and allow you to develop your skills in a targeted way
* You'll take on responsibility early on and will be able to manage your own projects
* Your instructors will guide you every step of the way and support you as you grow.
* We provide training with the goal of expanding our team in the long term—with real opportunities for your future
* Your satisfaction and well-being are important to us—that's why we create an environment where you feel comfortable and can thrive

Curious? On our website, you can learn more about NETWAYS and ICINGA, our customers, and what to expect as an apprentice with us. On the team page, you'll also get a first impression of who you'd be working with in the future.

If you're interested in growing with us and learning about the world of software development, your contact person, **Blerim Sheqa**, looks forward to receiving your application! Please send us your application materials (cover letter, resume, transcripts, references) to jobs@netways.de
